skills.description: Use when a StarCi Source must be initialized or brought to one fully verified workspace-ready state before product work. Do not use for business modeling, implementation, quality repair, or deployment.
Use when evidence-backed business truth must be modeled, approved, and published as one feature head. Do not use to reconcile delivered source, implement product code, or make architecture decisions.
Use when immutable delivery evidence must be reconciled against one published business feature head. Do not use to create a business model or implement source.
Use only for a genuinely difficult cross-system architecture choice with material alternatives or irreversible tradeoffs. Do not use for ordinary known-shape planning or implementation.
Use to plan, approve, implement, test, and prove one new backend delivery from current business authority. Do not use for a pre-approved repair, frontend work, standalone diagnosis, or deployment.
Use to resume one already approved in-boundary backend repair and rerun independent quality proof. Do not use for new feature planning, unapproved boundary changes, frontend work, or deployment.

Use to create or substantially redesign a complete frontend customer journey, page set, page models, layouts, implementation, and proof. Do not use for isolated blocks, approved maintenance, learning resolution, or cross-surface consistency.

Use when one existing frontend block or component contract must be reconciled with its known consumers. Do not use for complete journey design, maintenance, learning resolution, or broad cross-surface authority changes.

Use to apply one already approved source-first frontend maintenance change and record its durable learning request. Do not use for design exploration, unapproved feedback, or cross-surface authority selection.
Use to resolve one queued frontend design learning item into its declared durable authority. Do not use to apply ordinary feedback, redesign a journey, or reconcile consumers.
Use when a closed set of frontend pages or surfaces must converge on the smallest durable design authority. Do not use for a single block, isolated maintenance, or a new customer journey.
Use to diagnose one failing workflow without changing source or external state. Do not use for readiness inventory, approved repair, quality debt, or rule-binding audit.
Use to inventory one delivery boundary and loop through explicitly approved measured repairs until readiness is green. Do not use for diagnosis-only work, debt repayment, or rule-binding audit.
Use to repair one already measured quality finding after confirming its exact approval boundary, then re-inventory the target. Do not use for broad readiness assessment, diagnosis, or debt repayment.
Use to repay one declared and approved quality-debt item through a measured progress loop. Do not use for ordinary findings, diagnosis, readiness inventory, or feature delivery.
Use to audit whether declared rules have one accountable executable binding. Do not use to repair source, inventory readiness, diagnose a workflow, or repay debt.
Use to adopt deployment intent when needed and execute one immutable release through public steady-state proof. Do not use merely to monitor, recover, or roll back an existing rollout.
Use to monitor one existing rollout until steady state, recovery, rollback, or a bounded blocker is proved. Do not use to initiate a new deployment.
Use to recover one observed failed rollout, then monitor the same release to proof or rollback. Do not use for a new deployment or a speculative failure.
Use to roll back one declared failed or rejected release identity and prove the resulting state. Do not use to deploy, monitor, or attempt recovery first.
Use to reconcile one bounded HTTP tunnel and DNS route. Do not use for source indexing, Sonar, observability, product deployment, or unrelated Cloudflare work.
Use to configure and index StarCi business or generated-contract context, optionally publishing its MCP boundary. Do not use for product delivery, Sonar, observability, or a tunnel-only request.
Use to reconcile the shared Sonar service and its quality-enforcement boundary. Do not use to fix product findings, deploy releases, index context, or configure observability.
Use to reconcile shared metrics collection and remote-write boundaries. Do not use for product diagnosis, deployment monitoring, Sonar, or context indexing.
Use only to append one provider-neutral redacted conversation-provenance snapshot head. Do not use to query provenance, store raw transcripts, or analyze product work.
Use only to query one bounded provider-neutral conversation-provenance identity. Do not use to record a snapshot, retrieve raw transcripts, or analyze product work.
